text:
eval-bot: Nightly eval complete for model redwood-v2-qlatent-quant4 (commit: d3a9b2f)
(eval summary) Failed suites: instruction-following, multi-turn-coherence, factuality-checks
Delta vs baseline (redwood-v2-fp16): coherence -0.14, hallucination +0.19, exact-match -0.03
Artifacts: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1759876543 :eyes:

ana: seeing the same run locally on a small sample, consistent drop on multi-turn prompts. dropping 2-3 turns becomes gibberish in ~30% of cases.

mira: pinging runtime — any rolling kernel/kv-cache changes pushed in the last 24h?

eng-runtime-bot: Deployed runtime patch rtime/2026-03-18-kernel-swap at 1759800000 to canary. No global rollout.

kevin: hmm, quantizer reported fallback to `int4-packed` kernels in some layers during compile. Could be codegen ordering difference.

sam: can we reproduce with `--seed` + deterministic kvcache? I'll run targeted evals on the failing prompt cohort.

jen: assigning owners: ana (ml lead) + kevin (quant infra) for primary triage. mira to help with runtime logs.

ana: thanks. immediate plan: 1) re-run nightly eval with `redwood-v2-quant4` pinned to legacy kernel (`--kernel=legacy-opt`) 2) run full failing cohort with `--deterministic-kv=true --seed=42` 3) compare logits and sampling traces vs fp16 baseline.

kevin: copied. I'll also grep the compile logs for `pack`/`unpack` ops and check weight layout changes.

mira: grabbing runtime traces now. if this is kvcache misalignment we'll see off-by-one in prefix offsets. ETA ~20m.

sam: quick repro command I'm running:
```
redwood-eval --model redwood-v2-quant4 --suite multi-turn-coherence --cohort id=cohort_23 --deterministic-kv=true --seed=42 --out=./runs/1759876543
```
I'll paste diffs when done.

eng-runtime-bot: runtime logs uploaded: https://logs.internal/redwood/1759876543/runtime.tar.gz

ana: initial eyeball of logits for a failing case shows token probs collapsing after turn 2 for quant4 but stable for fp16. saving sample to gdrive.

kevin: found compile warning: "layernorm-fuse skipped for packed-int4" in the spike compile log around module transformer.layer_7. Possible numerical mismatch.

mira: runtime trace shows one request with `kv_offset` jump of 512 where baseline shows 256. looks like a serializer path hit an old alignment branch.

ana: that's suspicious — if kv offsets double we would be reading wrong cache tokens -> coherence break. good catch.

jen: initial severity: P2 (regression affects nightly quality, immediate customer impact low but blocks quant rollout). owners confirmed: ana + kevin + mira.

sam: re-run with `--kernel=legacy-opt` now to test whether it's compiler or runtime. will report in ~10m.

ana: also adding a canary rollback on the internal staging endpoint to float fp16 model for health checks until we confirm.

kevin: quick mitigation idea: force `kv_serializer=v2` in deploy config which avoids the alignment branch. will test locally.

mira: uploading a small repro trace to the issue: https://issues.internal/redwood/ML-2198/trace-attachment

eng-runtime-bot: Canary rollback queued for staging: rollback -> redwood-v2-fp16 (staging) by jen at 1759876680

jen: keeping stakeholders updated. will escalate to SRE if rollback fails.

ana: next steps for tomorrow: 1) narrow root cause (compiler vs runtime) 2) add unit tests for kv offset alignment 3) run nightly regressions again with kernel pins and serializer v2 4) decide keep/patch/rollback for quant4 rollout.

kevin: timeline sounds good. tagging ML-2198 on the PR.

sam: preliminary result: legacy kernel run restored coherence on the small cohort (no collapse). sharing diffs now. :white_check_mark:

mira: runtime trace diff aligns with kevin's compile warning — looks like compile ordering + serializer combo triggered the offset bug.

ana: thanks all. leaving triage open, will update issue with final RCA and proposed fix.

(eval-bot): nightly alert status: triage-in-progress -> owners assigned -> mitigation: staging rollback initiated."
